searchText: It was agreed to wait for how ropsten goes to see how to proceed. I think everyone agreed on the 2 and agreed to decide on more depending on tests but I’m not sure as the meeting gets confusing 😂 Tim’s Twitter said they agreed on 2-4 It says it is agreed that 2 months is a good length of time for the delay IF they were to do it. Ah damn My interpretation from the call was that the current plan is to delay the bomb by 2 months, but we will release that at the same time as Paris release so people just have to download once. That’s what I got from it 😅 thanks Ha that shows how little I understand of governance. My understanding was that no decision was made at all, although the people opposed to defusing the bomb signaled they would be persuaded of this plan (2 months at the same time as Paris). I find reading these signals harder than flirting when I was a teenager The difficult in understanding the process is a feature, not a bug. 😁 It makes the system *much* harder to capture. Doesn't help that it was in a zoom meeting with no video. I vote for big obvious polls in meetings 😂 set the threshold at 66%. Would make things a lot easier for the community to understand. The ambiguity is in large part because there is no actual EIP to make a decision about It's hard to get more than soft-ish commitments given there is no actual proposition. I think we have a weak consensus that _if_ we delay the bomb, coupling it to Paris is ideal, and 2-4 months is the delay we'd go for
